title: TCP Fast Open
explanation: TCP Fast Open is an extension that can let a client include application data in the initial TCP SYN, reducing the wait before a request can begin. A server issues a cookie that a client can present on a later connection. The server must support and enable the feature, and data sent before the handshake completes has replay-related security considerations.
takeaway: Evaluate TCP Fast Open on supported client and server paths, and account for replay risks, middlebox compatibility, and real workload measurements.
